title: Worksheet — Linear Equations (Class 10 NIOS Mathematics)
instructions: Attempt all 10 questions in your notebook. Show every step of your working for the subjective questions; choose the single best option for MCQs. Verify each solution by substitution. Total time: 50 minutes.

questions.question: The standard form of a linear equation in one variable is:
questions.explanation: Linear means the variable appears only to the first power; standard form is ax + b = 0 with a ≠ 0.

questions.question: A linear equation in two variables has exactly one solution.
questions.explanation: It has infinitely many solutions — every point on the line.

questions.question: The unique solution of ax + b = 0 (a ≠ 0) is x = ____.
Solve 3(x − 2) + 4 = 2x + 1. Show every step and verify.
Solve x/2 + (x + 1)/3 = 4.
questions.explanation: Clear denominators by the LCM, distribute, isolate.

questions.question: The sum of three consecutive odd integers is 75. Find the integers.
questions.answer: Let smallest = x; the three are x, x + 2, x + 4. Sum: 3x + 6 = 75 → x = 23. Integers: 23, 25, 27.
questions.explanation: Translate, form ONE equation, solve, list back.

questions.question: Solve by substitution: x + y = 7, x − y = 1.
questions.answer: From eq.1: y = 7 − x. Substitute into eq.2: x − (7 − x) = 1 → 2x − 7 = 1 → x = 4; y = 3. Solution (4, 3).
questions.explanation: Substitution is fastest when a coefficient is 1 or −1.

questions.question: Five pencils and three erasers cost ₹40; three pencils and two erasers cost ₹25. Find the price of each.
questions.answer: Let pencil = x, eraser = y. 5x + 3y = 40 and 3x + 2y = 25. Multiply eq.1 by 2 and eq.2 by 3: 10x + 6y = 80, 9x + 6y = 75. Subtract: x = 5; substitute: 15 + 2y = 25 → y = 5. Pencil ₹5; eraser ₹5.

questions.question: A motorboat travels 24 km downstream in 3 hours and the same distance upstream in 4 hours. Find the speed of the boat in still water and the speed of the current.
questions.answer: Let still-water speed = x km/h, current = y km/h. Downstream: x + y = 24/3 = 8. Upstream: x − y = 24/4 = 6. Add: 2x = 14 → x = 7; subtract: 2y = 2 → y = 1. Boat speed 7 km/h; current 1 km/h.
questions.explanation: Set up two linear equations from downstream / upstream times.
